import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        ArrayList<Long>[] buckets = new ArrayList[11];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
            buckets[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        long[] total_sum = new long[11];
        final long MOD1 = 998244353;
        final long MOD2 = 1000000007;
        long counter = 0;
        long temp_counter = 0;
        long answer = 0;

        // Helper function for mod1
        long mod1_func(long x) {
            return ((x % MOD1) + MOD1) % MOD1;
        }

        // Generate1 function
        class Generator1 {
            void generate(int level, long value) {
                if (value > n) return;
                if (level > 6) return;
                counter++;
                long val = mod1_func(counter - value);
                buckets[level].add(val);
                total_sum[level] += val;
                for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
                    generate(level + 1, value * 10 + digit);
                }
            }
        }

        // Generate2 function
        class Generator2 {
            void generate(int level, long value) {
                if (value > n) return;
                if (level >= 1) {
                    if (value * 10 * n > n && value * n + n - 1 <= n) {
                        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                            long val = mod1_func(counter - value);
                            List<Long> vec = buckets[i];
                            int pos = lowerBound(vec, MOD1 - val);
                            long size = vec.size();
                            long sum = total_sum[i];
                            answer = (answer + val * size + sum - MOD1 * (size - pos)) % MOD2;
                            if (answer < 0) answer += MOD2;
                        }
                        counter += temp_counter;
                        return;
                    }
                    counter++;
                    long val = mod1_func(counter - value);
                    answer = (answer + val) % MOD2;
                }
                int startDigit = (level == 0) ? 1 : 0;
                for (int digit = startDigit; digit <= 9; digit++) {
                    generate(level + 1, value * 10 + digit);
                }
            }
        }

        Generator1 gen1 = new Generator1();
        gen1.generate(0, 0);
        temp_counter = counter;
        counter = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(buckets[i]);
        }
        Generator2 gen2 = new Generator2();
        gen2.generate(0, 0);
        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    // Helper method for lower_bound
    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
